general_stories.fact: The study streak broke multiple times over the year of consistent Boot.dev work — life made maintaining a daily routine genuinely hard at points. Visible progress-tracking (day-streak counters, XP) was what pulled the habit back together each time rather than letting a broken streak end the effort altogether. Result: a 144-day streak badge (Feb 2026) and 2,730 lessons solved despite the breaks.

general_stories.fact: The guided projects themselves were the hardest part of the path — leaned on AI tools heavily for research when stuck, more than on the graded lesson content itself. What mattered wasn't finishing a guided project in isolation: concepts and patterns worked out there got carried over and actually implemented in independent projects afterward, rather than staying a one-off exercise.
